newsitem.title: USA: Cincinnati Bell unit to buy WorldCom unit.
newsitem.headline: Cincinnati Bell unit to buy WorldCom unit.

text.p: Cincinnati Bell Information Systems (CBIS) - a subsidiary of Cincinnati Bell Inc - said on Friday it has acquired the business and assets of ICS Information Technologies of Reston, Va.
ICS was a subsidiary of WorldCom Inc.
The company said that under the terms of the agreement, ICS and its staff of 80 will become part of CBIS. Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
ICS is an international provider of Summit, a wireline customer care and billing product, and Summit Call Manager, an invoice analysis tool.
